answer: One defence is Emerald cutter drilled bead assay witnessed by the facet charter: each drilled bead is a mine assay countersigned by the warden, so a farm must cut a hundred real emeralds by hand, and the hollow of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the beacon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The wander is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
